subject.title: qmd memory writer deadlocks permanently on zero-byte orphan lockfile (silent, survives restart)

question: Which released version first contains the SQLite-backed QMD write-coordination cutover, and should this issue be closed as fixed there or retained for explicit upgrade/Doctor documentation?
rationale: Current main and the published QMD contract indicate that the reported lock is retired, but the required fix-release provenance is not established and the reporter identifies a v2026.7.1-derived deployment as affected.

options.title: Confirm a fixed release and close
options.body: Verify the first release containing the QMD SQLite lease cutover, then close this issue with an upgrade and restart note.

options.title: Keep as upgrade guidance
options.body: Retain the issue briefly and add a targeted release-note or Doctor diagnostic path if affected v2026.7.1 installs need a user-visible recovery step.

recommendation.title: Confirm a fixed release and close
recommendation.body: Verify the first release containing the QMD SQLite lease cutover, then close this issue with an upgrade and restart note.

likelyOwner.reason: The QMD manager history ties this contributor most directly to the active QMD update and recovery path.
